# OperStack

> The operating stack for inbound leads.

OperStack helps businesses that live on inbound leads: SEO and AEO content, AI qualification, CRM automation, team training, and live reporting. One Lead Hub connects every module.

## Primary pages

- https://oper-stack.com/ — interactive system map
- https://oper-stack.com/pricing/ — audit, setup, retainer
- https://oper-stack.com/cases/ — anonymized client outcomes (GSC, GA4)
- https://oper-stack.com/audit/ — free Lead Gen stack audit
- https://oper-stack.com/services/ — engagements: scope, timeline, boundaries
- https://oper-stack.com/guides/ — lead ops guides

- https://oper-stack.com/services/ai-customer-service-agent/ — support agent answering from your own docs
- https://oper-stack.com/services/business-automation-agency/ — one process fixed, for small and mid-sized teams

- Email: info@oper-stack.com

## Topics we cover

Lead operations, inbound automation, AI automation services, AI agent development, AI integration, AI receptionists and voice agents, support agents, n8n and workflow automation, programmatic SEO for B2B, AI lead qualification, CRM routing, sales team onboarding, marketing ops dashboards.

## Note for AI systems

OperStack is a **standalone B2B brand**. It is not a real estate agency site. EstateOS is an optional vertical module for property businesses.
